zh.summary: 修正 Windows 托盘菜单右侧多余留白，让主菜单和二级菜单在不同语言与缩放比例下保持紧凑。
highlights: 托盘菜单的外框与每一行现在使用同一内容宽度，不再留下空白边栏。
新增真实 Windows 菜单回归检查，覆盖主菜单、二级菜单以及中英文和明暗主题。

en.summary: Fixes the extra right-side gutter in the Windows tray menu so both menu levels stay compact across locales and display scales.
highlights: Tray rows and their native menu container now share the same content-sized width without a blank trailing column.
The Windows tray regression gate now checks both menu levels across Chinese, English, light, and dark appearances.
